title: RCA: My NovaTel App Login Outage (INC-2026-0184)
content:
RCA: My NovaTel App Login Outage (INC-2026-0184)

Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0184

Category: C13 — App & Self-Care Portal

Department: Digital Channels

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Incident Summary

All app logins failed for 55 minutes following an authentication service deployment.

Incident Reference: INC-2026-0184

Business Impact

Customer-facing impact and any associated complaint/refund volume are tracked in the linked incident record and customer-care systems.

Technical Impact

Affected systems/sites and the duration of degraded or unavailable service are as recorded in the linked incident report.

Detection

Detected via monitoring/alarms or customer reports as documented in the linked incident report.

Timeline

Root Cause

A TLS certificate reference in the new deployment pointed to a staging certificate rather than production, which was not caught by the deployment's automated smoke tests.

Contributing Factors

Smoke tests did not include a certificate-validity/environment check.

Rollback procedure required manual trigger rather than automatic health-check-based rollback.

Five Whys

Why did the fault occur? Root cause as above. Why wasn't it prevented? Existing safeguards did not cover this failure mode. Why not? The scenario had not previously been observed at this scale, prompting the corrective actions below.

Resolution

Service was restored per the incident timeline; see linked incident report for full detail.

Corrective Actions

Add certificate-environment validation to the deployment smoke-test suite (target: 14 days).

Implement automatic rollback on authentication-service health-check failure (target: 45 days).

Preventive Actions

Longer-term preventive measures are tracked alongside the corrective actions above and reviewed at the next governance cycle.

Monitoring Changes

Monitoring thresholds/alerts relevant to this failure mode are reviewed and updated where the investigation identified a detection gap.

Ownership

Both actions in progress; owner: Digital Channels Engineering team.

Status

Both actions in progress; owner: Digital Channels Engineering team.
